Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes — a damaged or defective item is handled differently from a normal return. Regular returns/exchanges aren’t accepted because Bellesa products are final sale, but if an item arrived damaged or has a product flaw, we can review it under the damage/defect process. If you want, tell me whether the damage happened in shipping or is a flaw with the product itself.
